description: Storm Flood and Cyclone Warnings for Queensland is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Fire Department. Mapping data for the locations of Australian Warning System Storm, Flood and Cyclone Warnings by Queensland Fire and Emergency Services (QFES). The information is updated every 30 minutes. Points represent the general area of the warning. The CAPAU (XML) format file also include areas of the warning. (QFES was renamed QFD 01/07/2024). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Fire Department. Its tags are Cyclone, Flood, QFES, Queensland Fire and Emergency Services, Storm. It offers 4 resource(s) in geojson, kmz, xml. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by-4. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
